name: sg-bough
summary: Full-bleed hero running shader.gallery's bough: the shadow of a potted branch thrown on a wall by an unseen lamp, every leaf nodding on its own phase with its own edge softness, over a matched CSS lamp wash.

colors.description: Four palette colours. Omit to read --fx-c1 through --fx-c4 off the section, which is what keeps the shader and the CSS resting state on one palette.

swaySpeed.description: Rate the cluster pivots in the draft; every leaf nods on its own phase. Upstream default, range 0.05 to 0.8.

leafSize.description: Leaf size in CSS pixels. Upstream default, range 40 to 140.

penumbra.description: Edge softness; near leaves bite crisp, far ones swell into grey breaths. Upstream default, range 0 to 2.

deviations.what: The four u_palette colours are ours, not upstream's `midnight` preset.
deviations.why: bough/meta.json names a palette as a string only; the table it resolves against lives in @shader-gallery/runtime, a package paw-fx does not vendor. Ours is a lamplight set rather than the upstream midnight one: the shader draws pure occlusion of a warm wall glow, and a cold palette reads as a mistake rather than a choice, and the CSS resting state reads the same --fx-c1..--fx-c4.

deviations.what: Rendered through paw-fx's own WebGL runtime (effects/_shared/glsl-mount.js) rather than @shader-gallery/runtime.
deviations.why: Seam. Upstream ships the .frag with no module around it. The GLSL itself is byte-identical to upstream and lives in shader.frag beside index.js.
